intro: Lesson 25. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: سَأَلَ سَآئِلٌۢ بِعَذَابٍۢ وَاقِعٍۢ (١) لِّلْكَٰفِرِينَ لَيْسَ لَهُۥ دَافِعٌۭ (٢) مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ذِى ٱلْمَعَارِجِ (٣) تَعْرُجُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ فِى يَوْمٍۢ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُۥ خَمْسِينَ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍۢ (٤) فَٱصْبِرْ صَبْرًۭا جَمِيلًا (٥)

إِنَّهُمْ يَرَوْنَهُۥ بَعِيدًۭا (٦) وَنَرَىٰهُ قَرِيبًۭا (٧) يَوْمَ تَكُونُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ كَٱلْمُهْلِ (٨) وَتَكُونُ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَٱلْعِهْنِ (٩) وَلَا يَسْـَٔلُ حَمِيمٌ حَمِيمًۭا (١٠) يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ ۚ يَوَدُّ ٱلْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِى مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍۭ بِبَنِيهِ (١١)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: A supplicant asked for a punishment bound to happen To the disbelievers; of it there is no preventer.
[It is] from Allah, owner of the ways of ascent. The angels and the Spirit will ascend to Him during a Day the extent of which is fifty thousand years.
So be patient with gracious patience. Indeed, they see it [as] distant,
But We see it [as] near. On the Day the sky will be like murky oil,
And the mountains will be like wool, And no friend will ask [anything of] a friend,
They will be shown each other. The criminal will wish that he could be ransomed from the punishment of that Day by his children

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Ma'arij 70:1-11 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 70:1-11 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 70:1-11 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Find two madd muttasil in 70:1 to 11.
Explain 70:6 to 7: why do the deniers see the Day as far while Allah sees it as near?
questions.a: They doubt it, so it feels far; Allah knows it is certain and coming soon.

questions.q: How long is the day in 70:4?
questions.a: A) Fifty thousand years. 70:4: 'in a Day the extent of which is fifty thousand years.'

questions.q: Think again: 'So be patient with gracious patience' (70:5). What is the difference between ordinary patience and 'beautiful' patience?
questions.a: Beautiful patience (sabr jamil) has no complaining to people: we bear it calmly and turn to Allah.
